messages:
ana_cs: Heads up — I ran a quick audit on our CRM attrition-prob model. The top decile of "high attrition" accounts has a surprising 40% recent-login rate. Feels like signal drift from product-usage features.

marta_am: Ugh, that explains a few false-positive playbook fires we saw yesterday. Do we have a sample of labels vs features over time?

ana_cs: I attached a small sample in the audit doc (link in thread). Main ask: can we recalibrate the probability thresholds and gate playbook runs until we validate? Prefer a canary window. :eyes:

raj_engineer: Agree we should canary. Quick idea: include a rolling 14-day active_users_count feature and reweight. Sample SQL to compute recent usage bucket:```sql
-- rollup recent product activity
SELECT account_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users_14d,
       SUM(event_count) FILTER (WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '14 days') AS events_14d
FROM analytics.events
WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY account_id;
```

opsbot: AUTOMATION ALERT:  81 playbook executions in last 24h flagged as high-attrition; 23 had recent activity > 5 users. (rule: renewal-risk-high)

sam_cs_manager: Thanks — we need an ops-safe path. Proposal: pause automated outreach for the flagged cohort, run manual review for 200 randomized accounts, update threshold if >30% false positives. Can we do that in 48h? :calendar:

marta_am: I can own the manual review + sampling. I'll export a CSV and tag rows with reasons. Also will run a quick precision/recall calc.

raj_engineer: I can push a quick re-score DAG to Airflow for a canary group (10% of accounts) that computes new probs with the recent-activity feature. Command to trigger locally:```bash
airflow dags trigger --conf '{"canary":true,"pct":0.1}' crm_attrition_rescore_v2
```

ana_cs: Perfect. Once canary runs, we'll compare churn labels over 30 days and check playbook delta. If precision improves by >=7pp and recall drop <=3pp, we rollout.

sam_cs_manager: Add this to the runbook: rollback steps (disable DAG, revert threshold env var, notify CS leads). Also add metric dashboard: playbook hits, manual review FP rate, and renewal conversion delta.

marta_am: Will update runbook and post CSV by EOD.

raj_engineer: ETA: canary DAG queued, should finish scoring by tomorrow morning. I'll post logs and the rescore diff table.

ana_cs: Thank you all. After the canary we decide — priority: avoid noisy outreach during renewal season. :thumbsup:
